item.title: Senior Full-Stack .NET + React Developer
item.description:
About the Role

Join an established international B2B SaaS company (Australia, UK, US) building cloud solutions for customer communications and support operations. You'll keep critical production systems healthy, resolve defects, and deliver continuous product improvements, working autonomously in an async, distributed team and gradually taking ownership of larger initiatives.
 

Responsibilities

  • Provide technical support for business applications across UK and US operations
  • Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve production defects
  • Deliver enhancements requested by the business
  • Own tickets end to end, from investigation to resolution
  • Collaborate asynchronously with distributed teams and stakeholders
  • Work effectively with AI-assisted development tools
     

Requirements

  • React: 6+ years of hands-on experience
  • .NET / C#: 6+ years with modern .NET / .NET Core, REST APIs, microservices, and databases
  • AWS: solid experience with core cloud services
  • English: B2+, strong written and verbal communication
  • Autonomy: proven ability to work independently and drive issues to resolution
     

Nice to Have

  • Contact center, telephony, or customer engagement platform experience
  • Twilio / Twilio Flex / WebRTC
  • Interest in AI/LLM integrations
     

Schedule

Flexible hours, focused on UK and US (MST / UTC-7, Phoenix) business time. Ideally 2–3 hours of daily overlap with the Phoenix team. Occasional meetings with the Australian team.

item.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (Vue.js + Node.js)
item.description:
Hello everyone!

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer (Vue.js + Node.js) Engineer to join our team.

How many stages of the interview are there?

— Interview with the Recruiter — up to 30 min.;

— PM call — up to 30 min.;

— Technical interview with Ralabs — up to 1 hour;

— Interview with the Client — up to 1 hour.

 

Requirements:

  • 6+ years of experience in Full Stack development (Node.js + Vue.js);
  • 2+ years of Experience with MongoDB and Mongoose (models, schemas and validations, aggregation framework, performance troubleshooting, query optimization, index analysis, and database health monitoring)."
  • Experience with Vue.js (Vue 2/3, Composition/Options API, Vuex/Pinia, Vue Router)
  • Experience with Nuxt.js;
  • Strong knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript;
  • Experience with Serverless/Lambda functions (pet-project is fine);
  • Experience with Express.js and building RESTful APIs
  • Experience with Git and CI/CD pipelines;
  • Familiarity with Jira/Confluence and Scrum ceremonies (A/C, DoD, sprint planning, estimation);
  • Upper-intermediate or higher level of English.
  • Willingness and comfort working with legacy code in the core product;
  • Willingness to work not only with Vue, but also with vanilla JavaScript;
     

Would be a plus:

  • Experience with MongoAtlas;
  • Familiarity with Vuetify, Tailwind, Bootstrap, SASS/SCSS;
  • Degree in a technical field.
     

Responsibilities:

  • Development of web application features on both frontend and backend;
  • Building and maintaining Vue.js components, integrating with Node.js APIs;
  • Ensuring code quality and test coverage;
  • Participation in sprint planning and task estimation;
  • Direct communication with the development team and customers.

item.title: Senior Scientific Application Developer - Scientific Models
item.description:
The project

You will own the development of a capability for scientific models - a custom application we are building on the Datagrok platform for one of our pharma customers. It's a central place where scientists register, discover, run, and compare computational models. Models come from different teams, in different languages, with different inputs and outputs. Your job is to turn that into one coherent, fast, self-service experience.

 

This is not a ticket-driven role. You will "sit" with the customer's scientists, understand how they work, and translate that into working software.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Develop clean, high-performance, well-documented, production-level code
  • Own your backlog: prioritize, estimate, communicate status, and drive features from a conversation to production
  • Talk directly to the scientists and computational modelers: run demos, gather requirements, challenge assumptions, propose better ways to solve their problems on the platform
  • Contribute improvements back to the platform and public plugins where the project uncovers gaps

 

Requirements:

  • Expert-level TypeScript: you've designed and shipped non-trivial TS applications or libraries in pre-LLM era
  • Engineering range: building elegant solutions from scratch, evolving complex existing codebases, and contributing efficiently across the whole stack, UI to backend
  • Past projects in scientific or life-sciences software, complex modeling, or scientific computing (e.g., simulation engines, computational tools, statistical modeling apps, numerical/HPC code, etc.)
  • Fluent spoken and written English: you will be in customer-facing meetings weekly, presenting your work and negotiating scope with scientists
  • Willingness to learn new scientific domains
  • Demonstrated ability to self-manage: you've owned a project or major workstream end-to-end and can point to something that shipped because you drove it to completion

 

Nice to have:

  • Scientific background (STEM / life sciences)
  • Python, R, C++, or Julia (enough to read and integrate scientists' model code)
  • Experience with ML development and/or model lifecycle tooling (model registries, MLflow-style tracking, workflow engines)

 

We offer:

  • Fully remote work
  • Excellent growth opportunities in a highly dynamic, unique product company
  • Zero bureaucracy
  • Paid trainings and certifications
  • Competitive compensation

item.title: Senior Full Stack .NET+React Engineer (Azure must) (IRC294116)
item.description:
Job Description

6+ years of software development experience with the .NET platform (ASP.NET Core, C#)
Strong experience building and consuming REST APIs (OpenAPI, FluentValidation)
Knowledge of OAuth 2.0 flows is a plus
At least 2+ year of proven experience with Azure Cloud services (Service Bus, Azure Functions, CosmosDB)
Solid understanding of client-server application design and asynchronous programming
Experience with CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps or equivalent tools
Knowledge of containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) is a strong plus
Familiarity with low-code/no-code integrations (Power Apps, Power Automate) is desirable
Experience with Azure ML/AI services, document recognition, or data-driven workflows is an advantage
Proficiency in debugging, refactoring, and clean code design
Strong analytical skills with ability to ramp up quickly in new domains
Good written and verbal communication skills in English (Upper-Intermediate+)


Job Responsibilities

Design and implement cloud-native applications leveraging Azure Functions, Service Bus, and CosmosDB
Build and maintain microservices and APIs that integrate with multiple systems, including D365 and data platforms
Collaborate with stakeholders to define and negotiate API contracts and ensure reliable system integrations
Implement data processing and workflow services with a focus on scalability, performance, and resilience
Contribute to the design of low-code solutions integrating Azure ML/AI services for automation (e.g., document recognition, intelligent data extraction)
Participate in planning, estimation, and architecture discussions, providing technical guidance
Debug and resolve issues of various complexities across the stack
Work closely with DevOps and QA to ensure CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and deployment processes are efficient and robust
Follow coding standards and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the development team


Department/Project Description

GlobalLogic is searching for a motivated, results-driven, and innovative software engineer to join our project team at a dynamic startup specializing in pet insurance. Our client is a leading global holding company that is dedicated to developing an advanced pet insurance claims clearing solution designed to expedite and simplify the veterinary invoice reimbursement process for pet owners.

You will be working on a cutting-edge system built from scratch, leveraging Azure cloud services and adopting a low-code paradigm. The project adheres to industry best practices in quality assurance and project management, aiming to deliver exceptional results.

We are looking for an engineer who thrives in collaborative, supportive environments and is passionate about making a meaningful impact on people's lives. If you are enthusiastic about building innovative solutions and contributing to a cause that matters, this role could be an excellent fit for you.

item.title: Senior Python Full-Stack Engineer (Architecture Focus)
item.description:
About the Project

We are a product-driven company building a live commercial product with real users in a high-load environment.
The platform is actively growing — new features, scaling challenges, and architectural evolution.

We are looking for a Senior Python Full-Stack Engineer with strong backend and system design expertise who can take ownership of complex technical decisions and contribute to architectural evolution.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable backend services
  • Participate in architectural decisions
  • Improve system performance and scalability
  • Optimize database queries and indexing strategies
  • Ensure data consistency across services
  • Contribute to distributed system design decisions
  • Review code and mentor engineers

  • Work closely with product and engineering teams

     

Must-Have Requirements

  • 6+ years of commercial software development
  • Strong Python expertise (production-level experience)
  • Deep experience with Django / FastAPI / Flask
  • Strong knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred)
  • Experience designing scalable REST APIs
  • Solid understanding of:
    • Database indexing strategies (B-tree, Hash, Composite)
    • Query optimization & profiling (EXPLAIN, performance tuning)
    • Transactions & data consistency
  • Experience with microservices architecture
  • Understanding of distributed systems concepts:
    • Data consistency
    • Event-driven communication
    • Replication strategies
  • Experience with background processing (Celery, async workers)
  • Docker & Git

  • Production-level experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred)

     

Strong Plus

  • Experience with:

    • Distributed transactions (Saga pattern, eventual consistency)
    • Message brokers (Kafka / SQS / SNS / RabbitMQ)
    • High-load systems
    • Database scaling (replication, sharding, read replicas)
    • Observability tools (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana)
    • CI/CD pipelines

    Frontend

  • Experience with React (Next.js is a plus)
  • Understanding of frontend-backend integration
  • Ability to contribute to frontend architecture when needed
     

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Fully remote
  • Working hours: Mon–Fri 16:00–00:00 (UTC+X)
  • Direct impact on architecture and product decisions
  • Long-term collaboration

item.title: Principal Fullstack Developer(Node.js, React)
item.description:
We are looking for a Principal Fullstack Developer(Node.js, React) with a passion for creative game design and systems engineering. You won’t just be pulling tickets from a backlog: you’ll be the technical authority for our products. You will lead two completely different engineering ecosystems: the highly optimized, memory-sensitive world of game clients and the backend infrastructure. You will bridge the gap between creative vision and technical reality, ensuring that the incredible experience enjoyed by players is powered by a robust, secure and scalable backend.

 

Main Responsibilities

What You Will Do:

  • E2E Game Architecture: Design, implement, and maintain complete game features. You will seamlessly integrate scalable server-side backend services with high-performance client-side gameplay and UI logic
  • Decoupled Systems: Design a flexible, modular backend that efficiently serves data to various frontend game clients, ensuring seamless integration regardless of the client engine used
  • Full-Stack Optimization: Balance performance across the entire product. Optimize server-side load management and database queries while simultaneously managing client-side memory and frame rate stability across a wide range of devices
  • Unified Observability: Implement robust real-time data collection, logging, and crash reporting, to track the user journey from client-side actions to back-end server responses
  • System Health & Proactive QA: Monitor the entire stack to swiftly detect, diagnose, and resolve cross-domain issues – whether they originate as client-side crashes or backend server bottlenecks
  • Security & Risk Mitigation: Implement E2E security protocols for secure client-server communication. Protect sensitive user data on the server while deploying client-side risk mitigation, such as anti-cheat mechanisms and exploit prevention
  • Act as the Technical Translator: Serve as the core bridge connecting UI/UX designers, Game Designers, and engineering leadership. You will help translate creative requirements into actionable code while ensuring the backend can support those designs
  • Elevate the Team: Mentor developers in modern client-side and backend techniques, fostering a culture of high-quality code and technical ownership
  • Set the Standard for Documentation: Create and maintain a unified knowledge base covering both sides of the stack – from API specs and server infrastructure to engine integration manuals
  • Drive Agile alignment: Holistically scope features during sprints, ensuring technical requirements align with business goals while actively managing and reducing technical debt

What to Expect:

  • Strong Planning and prioritization: You will organize the plan so that you and the team can seamlessly shift gears from optimizing a memory allocation issue in the morning to designing a stateless architecture handling thousands of concurrent players in the afternoon
  • Stakeholder management: You will work with product owners and game designers to translate their vision into technical reality, reviewing mechanics and proposing a viable, performant alternative
  • Architecture engineering: You will marshal monitoring telemetry to ensure the servers stay up during massive traffic spikes and adjust the approach to facilitate high availability
  • Product engineering: You will balance the demands of shipping features fast against the necessity of keeping the codebase clean, scalable, and modular
  •  
  • 6+ years of development experience and 1+ year of leadership experience
  • iGaming/Gambling experience will be a huge plus
  • Proven Full-Stack Expertise: Deep professional experience in both game client development and scalable server-side backend architectures
  • High Tolerance for Complexity: You are comfortable diving into ambiguous problems and designing systems from the ground up
  • Proactive Problem Solver: You find and fix memory leaks, architecture flaws, or security vulnerabilities before they ever impact a player
  • Exceptional Communicator: You can explain complex backend constraints to non-technical stakeholders and break down creative requirements into clear engineering tasks
  • Experienced Leader: You have a track record of mentoring engineers, driving architectural decisions, and leading projects through the full software development lifecycle
  • Fluent English + Ukrainian or Russian - must‑have (for communicaton with ukrainian teammates) 

 

Stack:

  • Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript (Node.js), React
  • Frontend Graphics & Animation: WebGL rendering, 2D skeletal web animation
  • Real-time Communication & Messaging: WebSockets, Event streaming brokers, Remote Procedure Calls
  • Video Streaming: Ultra-low latency (sub-second) video streaming architecture utilizing WebRTC, WHIP, RTMP, and SRT for real-time ingest, combined with H5Live, Low-Latency HLS, MoQ, and ABR for global browser-based playback
  • Databases & Storage: Relational (SQL), Document (NoSQL), In-memory caching, Columnar/Analytics databases
  • Infrastructure & Orchestration: Cloud infrastructure, Containerization, Container orchestration
  • Observability & Monitoring: Distributed telemetry, Log aggregation, Time-series monitoring dashboards

 

We offer

  • Competitive Salary in EUR: with annual performance reviews to recognize your growth
  • Flexible Remote Work: balance productivity and comfort
  • Comprehensive Benefits: including medical insurance, psychologist support and Polish, Slovak speaking clubs
  • Generous Paid Time Off: 20 working days of paid vacation, plus 10 additional paid days off, 10 paid sick days, and all national holidays in your country
  • Professional Development Support: reimbursement for courses, trainings, and certifications
  • Well-being Perks: support for language classes, sports, massages, or life coaching
  • 6-Month Probation Period: a standard period to ensure a strong mutual fit for both you and the company

item.title: Senior Full-Stack WordPress Developer / Code Architect
item.description:
Ми шукаємо досвідченого Senior Full-Stack WordPress Developer / Code Architect (5+ років досвіду) для проєктування та розробки високонавантажених e-commerce рішень, складних інтеграцій та сучасних Web/AI-архітектур.

 

Основні вимоги :

  • Досвід: від 5–7 років комерційної розробки, з них мінімум 3 роки на WordPress/WooCommerce у високонавантажених проєктах.
  • WordPress (Core):
    • Глибоке розуміння ядра: hooks, actions/filters, WP_Query, WP REST API, WP-CLI, WP-Cron, transients, Options API.
    • Розробка кастомних тем з нуля без білдерів, child themes, CPT, taxonomies, meta boxes.
    • Розробка ООП-плагінів з нуля (а не набором функцій у functions.php).
    • Gutenberg (кастомні блоки на React, block patterns, FSE, theme.json).
    • ACF Pro / Meta Box, багатомовність (WPML, Polylang), Multisite.
    • Робота з легасі-кодом і безпечна міграція старих проєктів.
  • WooCommerce:
    • Хуки, перевизначення шаблонів, кастомні поля товарів та замовлень.
    • Власні payment gateways та shipping methods.
    • HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage), міграція зі старої схеми замовлень.
    • Оптимізація каталогів 10k+ SKU (фасетні фільтри, індексація, оптимізація запитів).
    • Товарні фіди (Google Merchant, Rozetka, Prom, Facebook), синхронізація з ERP/CRM, автоматичний парсинг & моніторинг цін через API.
    • Subscriptions, мультивалютність, складна логіка знижок і промо.
  • Backend PHP 8.1+ & DB:
    • ООП, SOLID, DI, namespaces, PSR-стандарти, Composer.
    • MySQL / MariaDB (складні JOIN, індекси, EXPLAIN, міграції), Redis / Memcached, черги задач і фонові процеси.
    • Тестування: PHPUnit, PHPStan/Psalm (рівень 6+), статичний аналіз у CI.
  • Frontend:
    • JS ES6+, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3/SCSS, Tailwind. Збірка: Vite, Webpack, npm/yarn.
    • React / Next.js (SSR/SSG/ISR, App Router, Zustand, Redux Toolkit, TanStack Query).
    • Headless WordPress (WPGraphQL, REST-інтеграція, гібридні архітектури).
    • Оптимізація Core Web Vitals, accessibility, адаптивність, кросбраузерність.
  • Python (Automation & Services):
    • Скрипти автоматизації, ETL, обробка великих масивів даних.
    • Парсинг: Playwright, Selenium, BeautifulSoup, обхід антибот-захисту.
    • FastAPI / Flask для внутрішніх сервісів і мікросервісів, pandas, планувальники задач.
  • DevOps & Інфраструктура:
    • Адміністрування VPS на Ubuntu/Debian (SSH, sudo, Nginx, тюнінг PHP-FPM, memory_limit, opcache).
    • SSL (Certbot, Let’s Encrypt), DNS, Cloudflare, CDN, безпека сервера (ufw/iptables, fail2ban).
    • Docker & docker-compose, CI/CD (GitHub Actions / GitLab CI).
    • Git (feature branches, rebase, code review), моніторинг (New Relic, Grafana, логи, алерти).
  • ШІ — Просунутий рівень (AI Integration):
    • Досвід роботи з LLM API (Anthropic, OpenAI): tool use, structured outputs, streaming.
    • Промпт-інжиніринг, AI-асистенти в щоденному циклі (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot).
    • RAG, embeddings, векторні бази (pgvector, Pinecone, Qdrant), MCP, агентні воркфлоу.
    • Впровадження AI-фіч у продукт (рекомендації, персоналізація, автогенерація описів товарів, чат-боти).
  • Роль Архітектора:
    • Проєктування архітектури з нуля, техдокументація (ADR, схеми даних).
    • Code review з поясненнями, декомпозиція задач, стандарти команди, менторство.
    • Комунікація з бізнесом: переклад вимог у технічні рішення та навпаки.


➕ Буде плюсом (Bonus Skills):

  • Laravel або Symfony, Node.js, GraphQL, Elasticsearch, Kubernetes, Shopify, інтеграції з маркетплейсами, досвід у e-commerce.


Софт-скіли & Англійська:

  • Самостійність, висока відповідальність за результат,ініціативність, вміння аргументовано заперечити.

  • Англійська: від B2 (Upper-Intermediate)

     

    Обов'язки:

  • Розробка та підтримка e-commerce рішень (WordPress/WooCommerce).
  • Створення та розвиток кастомних дашбордів на React/Next.js.
  • Повне адміністрування серверної частини та мережевих налаштувань (DNS/Cloudflare).
  • Технічне проєктування взаємодії (API) між різними частинами системи.

     Що ми пропонуємо:
  • Можливість працювати над цікавими проєктами без зайвої бюрократії.
  • Пряма комунікація та швидке прийняття рішень.
  • Простір для професійного росту та впровадження власних ідей.
  • Графік роботи з 10:00-19:00 та віддалений формат
  • Чіткі задачі, підтримка в команді, технічні інструкції
  • Оплачувані відпустки та лікарняні,профільні навчання та курси англійської
